target: AArch64 UTM-compatible QEMU, disposable VirtIO disk clone
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1026 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-stock-redsea-drive-find.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --probe-stock-redsea-file
result: pass: FilesFind found the nested RedSea fixture through disk:/ and D:/, excluded source-only /System/InFile.ZC for both namespaces, and found LATE.ZC when Fs->cur_dv was the RedSea drive. Case-insensitive RedSea and relative source lookups, empty-file behavior, persistence, compaction, and zstatus failed=0 also passed.
scope: This bridges FilesFind to the one read-only RedSea fixture exposed as D: in the ARM guest. It is not a general drive service, writable RedSea, removable-media support, Pi storage update, or physical UTM/Pi acceptance.
